themes.name: Supply Chain Geopolitical Hedging
themes.summary: Strategy to mitigate tariff and geopolitical risks by shifting assembly to India (Foxconn/Tata) and leveraging TSMC Arizona for silicon, while acknowledging remaining concentration in Taiwan for leading-edge nodes.

themes.name: Enterprise AI Monetization Shift
themes.summary: Transition from flat per-seat subscriptions to metered consumption (Copilot Credits) and higher-tier bundles (E7) to expand ARPU.

themes.name: Supply Chain Localization
themes.summary: Multi-billion-dollar fab commitments in Arizona, Japan, and Germany to hedge geopolitical risk, introducing near-term gross margin dilution.

themes.name: Edge AI Monetization via Installed Base
themes.summary: Thesis that Apple can monetize its 2.5B+ active devices through hardware upgrades (iPhone 18/Duo) and Services attach using capital-efficient Edge AI, avoiding massive data-center CapEx.

themes.name: Grid-to-Chip Power & Thermal Enablement
themes.summary: The strategic integration of utility-scale power solutions (microgrids, behind-the-meter) directly with high-density compute cooling and power distribution architectures to overcome grid interconnection bottlenecks.

themes.name: Custom Silicon Margin Defense
themes.summary: Use of proprietary hardware (Maia 300, Cobalt 200) and model routing to reduce inference COGS and defend cloud margins against third-party dependency.

themes.name: Industrial Consolidation in Liquid Cooling
themes.summary: Trend of fragmented startups being acquired by consolidated global electrical/thermal incumbents (Vertiv, Schneider, Eaton) to capture market share.

themes.name: Grid & Regulatory Bottlenecks
themes.summary: Investment thesis focusing on utility interconnection delays, permitting scrutiny, and local regulatory pushback against data centers, and how companies like Vertiv mitigate these via acquisitions (UIG).

themes.name: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging
themes.summary: CoWoS-L and leading-edge nodes (3nm, 2nm) are the definitive volume gatekeepers. Substrate warpage and thermal limits in multi-die architectures (Rubin Ultra) represent key technical bottlenecks.

themes.name: Governance & Key-Man Risk
themes.summary: Investment thesis focusing on execution, talent retention, and strategic cohesion risks arising from founder departure and regulatory probes.
